title: Odd and even numbers in pairs
examples: How do I know if a number is odd or even?

explain.say: Children line up in pairs. If everyone has a partner, the number is even. Look at the board. There are 8 dots in 2 rows of 4. Every dot has a partner, so 8 is even.

draw.text: Odd and even numbers in pairs

explain.say: Look at the pairs. 4 groups of 2 make 8. There is none left over, so 8 is even. Even means it makes pairs with none left over.
With 7, 1 child has no partner. A number with 1 left over is odd. Look at the 2 groups. Even numbers are 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. Odd numbers are 1, 3, 5, 7, 9.
Here is a quick check. Look at the last digit. If it is 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8, the number is even. 58 ends in 8, so it is even. Is 315 odd or even?
10 is 2 rows of 5, so 10 is even. Odd plus odd always makes even. 3 plus 5 is 8. Is the number of children in your class odd or even?

faq.a: An even number splits into pairs with none left over, like 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10. It always ends in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8.
An odd number has one left over when you make pairs, like 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9. It always ends in 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9.

faq.q: How do I know if a big number is odd or even?
faq.a: Only look at the last digit, the ones. 3,458 ends in 8, so it is even. 921 ends in 1, so it is odd.
asks: How do I know if a number is odd or even?

faq.a: Yes. Zero makes pairs with none left over, and it sits between the odd numbers 1 and minus 1. So 0 is even.

faq.q: What happens when I add odd and even numbers?
faq.a: Even plus even is even, odd plus odd is even, and odd plus even is odd. For example, 3 plus 5 is 8, but 3 plus 4 is 7.

facts: Every even number ends in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8.
The sum of two odd numbers is always even.

quiz.say: Look at the 3 numbers. Which number is odd?
quiz.why: 37 ends in 7. When you make pairs, 1 is left over.

wrong.0: 48 ends in 8, so it is even.
wrong.2: 50 ends in 0, so it is even.

quiz.say: Add 5 and 7. Is the answer odd or even?
quiz.why: 5 plus 7 is 12. 12 ends in 2, so it is even.

wrong.0: 12 is right. It ends in 2, so it is even.
wrong.1: 5 plus 7 is 12. Count on 7 from 5 again.
